terms.meaning: A finer land subdivision number used alongside the khata number.

sections.name: File setup, POST
sections.title: Search handler
sections.what: Passes the request body to the search service and returns the result, or a 400 error if the service returns nothing.
sections.why: Keeps the route thin and leaves the rules in the service.
sections.watch_out: The route depends on the service returning nothing for bad input, so changing that behavior breaks the 400 response.

summary: Web address to search synthetic official land records.
purpose: Lets a user look up a record by location and khata or khesra number.
why: Reason not stated in the code.
how: Reads the request body and passes it to the search service. If the service returns a result, it is returned. If not, a 400 response explains that district, circle, mauza, and a khata or khesra are required.
inputs: JSON body with district, circle, mauza, and a khata or khesra number.
outputs: The search result, or a 400 with code INVALID_SYNTHETIC_SEARCH.
risks: Input checking happens in the service, not here. Invalid JSON becomes an empty value, so the service must handle that safely.
debug: A 400 means the service rejected the input. Check the search rules in the official record service.
